display_long_description:
# THIS IS A DEMO VERSION
# FULL GAME HERE:
https://www.meta.com/experiences/just-one-man/8802299089893750/

**JUST ONE MAN** is a hack-and-slash game where you are the OVERPOWERED VILLAIN. Stylishly slaughter enemies with a variety of weapons, combo attacks, and overpowered abilities while listening to aggressive beats. Invent your own playstyle and achieve highest scores by performing the wildest combos you can imagine.

[media]

# SMOOTH AND SATISFYING MELEE COMBAT
Visceral slices, impactful punches, lighting fast dashing. The fighting is designed only one goal in mind: it has to feel as satisfying as possible. Immerse into the flow of the combat and become the ultimate martial arts master.

[media]

# EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
The basics are simple, everyone can learn them in minutes. It is up to you, what kind of fighting style you want to come up with, but only the **COOLEST COMBOS** and **EDGIEST EXECUTIONS** get you that sought after SSS-rank.

[media]

# DEMO FEATURES  
* **PUNCH, SLICE, PARRY, DODGE** and **DASH** your way through unrelenting waves of enemies
* Use your **FISTS** to punch enemies into a pulp
* Grab the **WEAPONS** from fallen enemies to vary your combat style
* Unleash powerful **ABILITIES**, unique for each weapon
* Scoring system that rewards **THE COOLEST COMBOS**
* All the while listening to the **BANGING SOUNDTRACK**

[media]

Are you ready to **BECOME THE VILLAIN?**
